title: WPMS/2422/2014 of Ameer Alam Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2422 of 2014
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.

Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. A.K. Joshi, Addl. C.S.C. for the
State/respondents.
Ms. Ranjana, Chief Development Officer,
Haridwar, at present holding the charge of
District Magistrate/Collector, Haridwar is
present in person before this Court in
compliance of this Court's order dated
22.12.2014.
Mr. A.K. Joshi, Addl. C.S.C. appearing for
the State/respondent has handed over the
supplementary counter affidavit of Ms.
Ranjana, In- Charge Collector, Haridwar
annexing therewith the copies of the inquiry
report as well as order dated 02.01.2015 passed
by the District Magistrate, Haridwar. Same is
taken on record.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel
appearing for the petitioner, in view of the
contents of the supplementary counter filed
today, seeks permission to withdraw this
petition with liberty to file fresh, challenging
the inquiry report as well as order dated
02.01.2015.
Order accordingly.
